TERMS AND CONDITIONS
The following terms and conditions, which are subject to change without notice, apply to the services offered by and
rates issued by Kandili Camps Ltd (“the Company”). It is a condition of making a reservation with the Company that
these terms and conditions are accepted in full. These terms and conditions are applicable to all Tour Operators or
Destination Management Companies or Travel Agents or individuals (“the Clients”) booking directly with the
Company (collectively called “the Parties”). Any Operator arranging services with the Company on behalf of its Client
does so as that Client’s agent and agrees to pass on these terms and conditions to its Client and to ensure its Client
is bound by them. It is a requirement of using the services offered by the Company that these terms and conditions
are accepted in full, and the Parties accept that by making a booking with the Company these terms and conditions
are accepted in full.
These Terms & Conditions are subject to change without notice. It is hereby recorded that the Parties wish to enter
into this Agreement in terms of which the Company will provide services and tours and arrange tailor-made
packages for the Operator and or Clients, in consideration for which the Company will be entitled to the payments
and other charges referred to below. This Agreement supersedes and replaces any previous agreement between the
Operator and or the Client and the Company relating to the subject matter hereof. Once a booking is confirmed by
the Operator and or the Client, this Agreement will be deemed for all purposes in law to have been signed by the
Parties and will constitute a legally binding agreement between the Parties. “Clients” includes all parties travelling
and their executors, heirs, legal representatives and successors in title.

pages.text:
Taxes
All relevant taxes are included in the quoted rates
In case of any increase in Government taxes, Park Fees, Conservation Fees, Service Charges, or material currency
fluctuations, material fuel cost changes, or other material increases in operating costs beyond our control, we reserve the
right to adjust all contract rates accordingly from the date of such change without prior notice
Currency
All non-resident rates are quoted in United States Dollars
All Kenya Resident rates are quoted in Kenya Shillings
Check in / check out times
Check-in is at 14.00 hrs
Check-out is at 10.00 hrs regardless of departure time
Late check out between 10.00hrs and 13.00hrs, will be charged at US$100 per adult and US$50 per child, subject to
availability (including lunch if required)
Subject to room availability, the camp will, at its sole discretion, endeavour to accommodate requests for early arrivals and
/ or late check-outs
Groups
Groups are defined as any booking using 4 or more tents
For groups of 15 paying clients or more we will allow a guest or one tour leader to be accommodated free of charge. Park
fees, conservation fees and extras such as drinks will be payable
Special requirements for groups will be discussed on a case-by-case basis
Payment terms for groups will be discussed and agreed on a case-by-case basis, depending on the nature and timing of the
group

pages.text:
Availability and provisional bookings
Please email booking@kandilicamp.com or call +254 748 152 968
Provisional bookings must be made by email and will be held for 7 days. If not confirmed via payment of a deposit, the
booking will be released
Confirmation of bookings:
Bookings are only confirmed once a written confirmation AND a deposit has been received
Confirmations must also state;
Date and time of arrival and departure
Mode of arrival and departure (road, air)
Number of guests, rooming list, dietary requirements, room configuration
Extra activities required
For Kenya Resident bookings, proof of residency may be required. Proof of residency will be a Kenyan national ID card or
driving license or valid Alien Card or valid Work Permit
Payment terms
Payment terms must be adhered to
Payment must be in the currency invoiced
A deposit of 30% is required to confirm a booking
Full payment is required 60 days before arrival (for peak season bookings) and 45 days before arrival at other times of year
Payment must be made by electronic transfer to Kandili Camps Ltd accounts at NCBA in KENYA
Cash is not accepted except as allowed for the payment of local extras in Camp under 22.3 below
Management reserves the right to deny services if full payment is not made in accordance with these terms and conditions

pages.text:
Cancellation or booking reduction policy
All cancellations or booking reductions must be received in writing to booking@kandilicamp.com
Cancellations or booking reductions are not valid until / unless acknowledged by Kandili Camps Ltd in writing
Between 60 and 35 days of arrival,30% of the total cost will be charged
Between 34 and 20 days of arrival,50% of the total cost will be charged
Between 19 days and the date of arrival (or no show), 100% of the cost will be charged
Refunds
Should any client arrive late or request and early departure, no refund will be granted
Whilst Kandili Camp management will ensure that all anticipated accommodation will be available as planned, there shall be
no claim of any nature against Kandili Camps Ltd for a refund (either in part or in full) if any accommodation is unavailable
and a reasonable alternative was found - or if guests were unable to make use of the services for any reason
Any refund that is made is done at the sole discretion of Kandili Camps Ltd
Credit / Debit card policy
Payment for accommodation can be done by bank transfer or credit / debit card link. Charges for such payments will be
made by the remitter / payer
Any client paying by credit / debit card will be requested to share a copy of their passport or ID before payment is made
All payments for extras are to be settledby cash or card upon checkout. Only US dollars, Euro and Kenya Shillings are
accepted
In case of US dollar cash, only notes issued after 2009 are accepted
Any foreign currency notes must be in good condition and unmarked in any way

REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES: The Clients acknowledge that they understand and accept the real risks that are
inherent in a safari and that they participate in such a safari in the full knowledge that such risks exist and hereby confirm
that they voluntarily participate in such activities at their own risk. These risks arise, inter alia, from close proximity to wild
dangerous and unpredictable wildlife (including mammals, reptiles, amphibians and birds), accommodation in unfenced and
tented facilities, fire, streams rivers lakes and marshes that can be prone to flooding without warning, travel in remote areas
that lack early warning systems, and tropical and communicable diseases. In the case of a Tour Operator, that Tour Operator
confirms that he / she has communicated these risks to their client.
DISCLAIMER -This agreement is made subject to and shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Kenya.
Nothing in this agreement shall limit or exclude Kandili Camp’s liability for: (a) death or personal injury caused by its direct
and substantial negligence, or the direct and substantial negligence of its employees, agents or subcontractors (as
applicable); (b) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation or willful default; and (c) any matter in respect of which it would be
unlawful for Kandili Camp’s to exclude or restrict liability. Subject to such provision and to the extent permissible under
applicable law, neither Kandili Camp, nor any person acting for, through or on its behalf shall be liable for any loss or
damage whatsoever and, without restricting the generality of the foregoing, shall not be responsible for direct, indirect or
consequential loss or damage arising from any errors or omission, contained in any brochure or other literature, late or non-
confirmation or acceptance of bookings occasioned by the agent or guest; or loss or damage to any property, or loss or
damage caused by delays, sickness, personal injury or death (irrespective of the cause of such injury, death, loss or damage)
except if such a liability or claim isas a direct and substantial result of the gross negligence or willful misconduct of Kandili
Camp Ltd. Kandili Camp Ltd may, at its discretion and without liability or cost to itself, at any time cancel or terminate the
guest's booking and in particular without limiting the generality of the foregoing, it shall be entitled to do so in the event of
the illness or the illegal or incompatible behaviour of the guest, or under any other cause permitted by these terms and who
shall in such circumstances not be entitled to any refund.
